body: Fix spec android-macos-e2e-fixes, phase 3 grounding: root causes returned by two read-only investigations (confirmed by reading code at d36b748, not yet by probe). Full notes: session scratchpad notes.md; both go into the spec's root-cause section.U+000AU+000AH2 (floated photo placement) and C1 (empty line after photo removal) are behaviour the composer spec asks for, so they are not coding slips. Pressing Enter in plain text inserts one line break, which continues the same markdown paragraph (block_parser.dart:533, 575). Photos move only between top-level blocks (photo_relocation.dart:71, 91-98), a drag snaps to the nearest block end (photo_drag.dart:82-96), and Move down goes to the end of the next block (photo_relocation.dart:109-117). So lines typed with Enter beside a float are one unreachable block. Spec rules P3, P4 and P6 in composer-editor-core.md, plus decision "a drop never splits a paragraph" (composer-editor-core.decisions.md:14), pin this. C1 comes from _removalRange keeping an empty line when a single line break sits on both sides (photo_relocation.dart:273-297), which spec P3 rule 1 requires. Fixing either needs an owner ruling: whether "paragraph" there means the markdown paragraph or a line typed with Enter. Twins: toolbar Move up/down, mouse and touch drag, Finder drop, Add memory target, photo paste, table insert, and every removal path. On Android, portrait phones never float photos (the column needs 30 em, photo_planner.dart:8), but Move down skips Enter-lines the same way.U+000AU+000AH6 (text fields unnamed on macOS) is a Flutter engine limitation. For text fields, the macOS delegate swaps in a hidden FlutterTextField (an NSTextField), which never sets accessibilityLabel or a placeholder (FlutterPlatformNodeDelegateMac.mm:30-45, FlutterTextInputSemanticsObject.mm:91-184). A stock TextField is equally unnamed. App-side sub-gap: Search and the photo caption name themselves only by hint text, which drops out of semantics once text is typed, so TalkBack also loses the name.U+000AU+000AH7: the macOS-only sidebar rail items are a GestureDetector with no Semantics (sidebar_shell.dart:181-219), so they read as static text. The phone tab bar does it right (bottom_bar_shell.dart:104-145). No tab role reaches macOS; button plus selected, or radio, can. The dismiss backdrops are Flutter's ModalBarrier, which has no button flag; this is the same cause as Android's 17 missing-role barriers, which a11y-fixes.decisions.md accepted as standard Flutter behaviour.U+000AU+000AC6: the search clear button is tooltip-only (search_field.dart:49-53), and macOS drops tooltips. The Text size slider has no label or value formatter (settings_slider.dart:31-39) and reads "50%" for Medium. AC2 (scrubber) comes from slider:true with no increase or decrease actions before play (video_scrubber.dart:193-209).
